alt: A carved trout relief panel in a kraft gift box with tissue paper and a pine sprig, ready to give
scene: GIFTING SCENE, wide magazine opening shot. The carved panel from image 1, finished in the house finish, lies nested in an open kraft-brown gift box on a bed of ivory tissue paper, a sprig of real pine and a length of undyed linen ribbon beside it, the box lid resting behind. Warm late-afternoon window light from the left. The panel fills about 55% of the frame and is the clear hero. A softly out-of-focus wooden table and a hint of a fireplace in the far background.

alt: Whitetail buck relief carving hanging above a stone fireplace mantel in a log cabin
scene: The carved panel from image 1, in the house finish, hangs centred on a rough timber wall above a stone fireplace mantel in a log cabin. A low fire glows below, two brass candlesticks and a stack of old books on the mantel, a plaid wool blanket over a leather chair arm at the edge of frame. Warm firelight from below-left and cool window light from the right. The carving is sharp and reads clearly; the room falls softly out of focus.

alt: Carved Face of Christ relief on a quiet home wall beside a small shelf with a candle
scene: The carved panel from image 1, in the house finish, hangs on a plain cream plaster wall in a quiet home hallway. Below it, a small oak shelf holds a single lit beeswax candle in a simple holder and a closed leather-bound book. Soft, reverent morning light from a window at the left. Nothing else in frame. Calm, dignified, unstaged.

alt: Hands lifting a carved owl family relief out of a gift box at a kitchen table
scene: Two hands lift the carved panel from image 1, in the house finish, up out of an open kraft gift box lined with ivory tissue, at a farmhouse kitchen table. A mug of coffee, a folded handwritten card and a strip of linen ribbon lie on the table. Bright, soft morning light from a window at the left. The carving faces the camera and is fully visible between the hands.

alt: Carved Highland cow serving tray filled with cheese, grapes and crackers on a dining table
scene: The carved serving tray from image 1, in the house finish, sits flat on a linen runner on a dark walnut dining table, its compartments filled with cubes of aged cheddar, red grapes, water crackers, dried apricots and walnuts. A small dish of honey with a wooden dipper and two stemmed glasses stand behind it. Warm evening candlelight from the left plus soft overhead light. The tray is fully visible, filling about 65% of the frame, shot from a three-quarter angle above.

alt: A finished relief carving being gift wrapped in kraft paper with twine and a sprig of pine
scene: A GIFT. The finished panel from image 1, in the house finish, lies on the bench half wrapped in brown kraft paper, a length of natural twine tied in a bow across one corner, a small sprig of pine tucked under the twine, and a blank kraft tag. Two hands are smoothing the paper down. Warm evening light, festive but restrained. No writing anywhere.
